breaking.change: Look change, moves frames: in a 2D project (project.ogt's `profile "2d"`) the default antialias, `tier` or left out, now resolves to 4x MSAA instead of TAA, whose jitter and bilinear history blend softened nearest-sampled pixel art (a sprite kept about 0.7 of its edge contrast). A 3D project still resolves to TAA; a game that names a method keeps it.
breaking.fix: To keep TAA in a 2D game, set `render: { antialias: "taa" }` in GameDesc (or `antialias taa` in its look).

fixed.summary: Moves frames: under 4x MSAA a sprite's or tile's uv is interpolated at a covered sample (centroid) instead of the pixel centre, so an edge pixel no longer reads the next cell of its atlas; a tilemap's rows had a faint seam in the colour of the neighbouring tile (top-down's path tiles). One sample per pixel draws as before.
